club.description: Potteries United carries the ceramic heritage of Stoke-on-Trent, a city formed by the pottery towns that grew together. Craft, labour and the distinct identity of the Potteries are central to the club's sense of place.

descriptions.de: Potteries United trägt das Keramikerbe von Stoke-on-Trent in sich, einer Stadt, die aus zusammengewachsenen Töpferorten entstand. Handwerk, Arbeit und die eigenständige Identität der Potteries stehen im Mittelpunkt des Vereins.
descriptions.es: Potteries United representa el legado cerámico de Stoke-on-Trent, una ciudad formada por la unión de localidades alfareras. La artesanía, el trabajo y la identidad singular de las Potteries son fundamentales para el club.
descriptions.fr: Potteries United porte l'héritage de la céramique de Stoke-on-Trent, une ville née du regroupement de plusieurs bourgs potiers. Le savoir-faire, le travail et l'identité particulière des Potteries sont au cœur du club.
descriptions.it: Potteries United custodisce l'eredità ceramica di Stoke-on-Trent, città nata dall'unione di diversi centri di produzione della ceramica. Artigianato, lavoro e identità peculiare delle Potteries sono al centro del club.
descriptions.en: Potteries United carries the ceramic heritage of Stoke-on-Trent, a city formed by the pottery towns that grew together. Craft, labour and the distinct identity of the Potteries are central to the club's sense of place.
